leads.claim: The Galileo Project is conducting an expedition to retrieve fragments of the IM1 object to determine if its material strength indicates an artificial origin.
leads.why: The text describes a specific effort to retrieve physical material, though it is a scientific search rather than a claim of government custody of recovered UAP debris.
